name: Expandable Card
description: An ultra-smooth, scroll-aware card expansion layout inspired by the App Store.
longDescription: A highly coveted App Store style expandable card transition. Built entirely on the UI thread with React Native Reanimated, it dynamically tracks the background list scroll position to ensure flawlessly smooth expansion and collapse physics.
author: nativecn-ui

props.name: data
props.description: An array of objects containing id, category, title, image, and content for each card.

usage.title: Basic Usage
usage.description: Render a scrollable list of expandable cards.

steps: Copy ExpandableCard.tsx to your components folder
Import and provide your array of cards
